intro: Detonation at a Distance sends an adventurer seeking specialized explosives expertise across the capital of Stormwind. After being prompted by the eccentric gnome tinkerer Sprite Jumpsprocket, you are directed to Stormwind Intelligence to procure a remote detonator.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator - why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
